lines.en: label harukadate20:
I tap on Haruka’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我点开手机里 Haruka 的名字，等着她接。

lines.en: It’s been a little while since the two of us have actually done anything and-
lines.zh: 我们俩已经有一阵子没真的做过什么了，而且——

lines.en: Wait.
lines.zh: 等等。

lines.en: {i}Have{/i} we actually done anything?
lines.zh: 我们真的做{i}过{/i}什么吗？

lines.en: I feel like every time the two of us hang out it’s either at her house, the cafe, or my place.
lines.zh: 感觉每次我们俩一起出去，不是在她的房子，就是咖啡馆，或者我家。

lines.en: Not that I have a problem with that, but...
lines.zh: 倒不是我有什么不满，只是……

lines.en: I can’t imagine it’s entirely fulfilling for her.
lines.zh: 我想这对她来说，大概谈不上多充实。

lines.en: : Hey, what’s up?
lines.zh: : 嘿，怎么啦？

lines.en: : Hey. What are you doing tonight?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你今晚干什么？

lines.en: : Probably crying and eating ice cream again. You know how it is.
lines.zh: : 大概又是哭着吃冰淇淋。你懂的。

lines.en: : Want to come out and do something?
lines.zh: : 要不要出来做点什么？

lines.en: : Can you wait like...two hours? I’m still at work.
lines.zh: : 你能等个……两小时吗？我还在上班。

lines.en: : Still? Don’t you normally get off before dinner?
lines.zh: : 还在？你平时不是晚饭前就下班了吗？

lines.en: : Normally, yes. But it’s been really busy and I didn’t want to leave Molly and the other part timer alone, so...
lines.zh: : 平时是。不过今天实在太忙，我不想把 Molly 和另一个兼职生单独丢下，所以……

lines.en: : Because you were worried about her or because you wanted to keep your store from exploding?
lines.zh: : 是因为担心她，还是因为你想保住自己的店不被炸上天？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 都有。

lines.en: : But there were two-
lines.zh: : 可那有两个人——

lines.en: : Hey! Why don’t you come hang out here in the meantime? Your [niece] and her friend are here too.
lines.zh: : 嘿！那你要不要先过来这儿待着？你 [niece] 和她的朋友也在。

lines.en: I mean, it’s not like I have anything else going on, so...
lines.zh: 反正我也没什么别的事，所以……

lines.en: : Sure. I’ll start heading over now.
lines.zh: : 好啊。我现在就过去。

lines.en: : Cool! I’ll see you soon, then.
lines.zh: : 太好了！那待会儿见。

lines.en: I hang up the phone and begin walking over to the cafe.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，开始往咖啡馆走。

lines.en: It seems that my awesome and spontaneous plan of actually going out and doing something for once is basically trashed since Haruka can’t escape work yet, but at least I’ll still get to see her.
lines.zh: 看来我那个“终于出门做点什么”的绝妙即兴计划，基本是泡汤了——Haruka 还脱不开身，不过至少我还能见着她。

lines.en: Teenagers are great and all because...yeah. But it’s still a nice break being able to hang out with someone my age who...shares the same interests as I do.
lines.zh: 青少年当然很好，原因嘛……你知道的。但能跟一个和我同龄、又……跟我兴趣相投的人待在一起，依然是种不错的调剂。

lines.en: Frankly, there aren’t many girls out there like that.
lines.zh: 说实话，这样的女孩可不多。

lines.en: At least not that I know of.
lines.zh: 至少就我所知不多。

lines.en: As always, my hands find their way into my pockets and my legs find their way ahead of themselves, bringing me closer to my destination with each and every step.
lines.zh: 一如既往，我的手自己插进了口袋，腿也自顾自地迈开，每一步都把我带得离目的地更近一些。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty1
: Hey! That was quicker than I expected!
lines.zh: : 嘿！比我想的快多了！

lines.en: : Hey, Haruka. Hey, everyone else.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Haruka。嘿，其他人。

lines.en: : Lumping me in with “everyone else” and addressing the cafe lady by her name makes it sound like you aren’t here to see me.
lines.zh: : 把我归进“其他人”里，还直呼咖啡馆小姐的名字，听起来就像你不是来看我的。

lines.en: : How would I have even known you were here?
lines.zh: : 我怎么会知道你在这儿？

lines.en: : You mean you’re not constantly watching the GPS tracker on my phone to see where I’m hanging out like I do with you?
lines.zh: : 你是说，你没有像我盯你那样，一直盯着手机上的 GPS 定位看我在哪儿鬼混？

lines.en: : I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，你说什么？

lines.en: : Do you need anything? Coffee? Tea? A new [niece]?
lines.zh: : 需要点什么吗？咖啡？茶？还是换个新 [niece]？

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty2
: I will destroy everything you love.
lines.zh: : 我要毁掉你所爱的一切。

lines.en: : Joke’s on you. I have nothing left but this cafe.
lines.zh: : 你失算了。除了这家咖啡馆，我什么都没剩下。

lines.en: : I’m fine, thanks. I didn’t really come here to buy anything.
lines.zh: : 我不用了，谢谢。我来这儿本来也不是为了买东西。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty3
: Okay. But know in the future that I have the right to refuse service to anyone I want. And if you’re just going to loiter around the place, I won’t let you inside anymore.
lines.zh: : 好吧。不过你以后记住，我有权拒绝接待任何我想拒绝的客人。你要是只打算在这儿瞎晃悠，我就不再放你进来了。

lines.en: : Well if that’s the kind of business you’re running, I’ll just have to excuse myself.
lines.zh: : 既然你是这么做生意的，那我只好告辞了。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty4
: Wait, no. Take me with you.
lines.zh: : 等等，别。带我一起走。

lines.en: : I don’t want to be here anymore. I’ve been on my feet since this morning and my back is literally killing me.
lines.zh: : 我一刻都不想在这儿待了。我从早上站到现在，腰真的快断了。

lines.en: : Gee, I wonder why.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，我想知道是为什么呢。

lines.en: : Yes, boobs. They are things I have.
lines.zh: : 对，胸。这东西我是有的。

lines.en: : Point is, I’m in pain. Please help.
lines.zh: : 重点是，我很疼。求帮忙。

lines.en: : I mean...I guess I could hold them for you and...take some of the weight off of your back or something.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……我可以帮你托着它们，这样……能给你的腰减点负担什么的。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty5
: If that is what must be done for the sake of my spinal health...
lines.zh: : 既然是为了我的脊椎健康，非做不可的话……

lines.en: : Do I even need to say anything here?
lines.zh: : 这种时候还需要我说什么吗？

lines.en: : You don’t. I’m pretty sure Maya’s look says enough for the two of you combined.
lines.zh: : 不用。Maya 那个眼神，大概已经把你们俩想说的都说完了。

lines.en: : You’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你真恶心。

lines.en: : Thank you for explaining exactly what the look entails, Maya. I would have had no idea otherwise.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你把这个眼神的含义解释得这么清楚，Maya。不然我肯定猜不出来。

lines.en: : Since when do you even talk to anyone your age? This entire scenario is weird.
lines.zh: : 你什么时候开始跟同龄人说话了？整个场面都怪怪的。

lines.en: : You really don’t have to stay around any longer, Haruka. I’m fine on my own now.
lines.zh: : 你真的不用再待下去了，Haruka。我现在一个人没问题。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty6
: I know I don’t {i}have{/i} to...but I’d feel bad otherwise. The kitchen’s an absolute wreck right now.
lines.zh: : 我知道不{i}用{/i}……可是不这么做我心里过意不去。厨房现在乱得一塌糊涂。

lines.en: : I’ll just stay a little later to help the other girl clean up back there. Go out and enjoy yourself.
lines.zh: : 我多留一会儿，帮另外一个女孩把后面收拾干净就行。你出去好好玩吧。

lines.en: : It’s the least I can do after you helped me out during the great cafe calamity.
lines.zh: : 上次“咖啡馆大灾难”你帮了我，这点事算是我最起码的回报。

lines.en: : Cafe...calamity? Is something wrong, Molly?
lines.zh: : 咖啡馆……大灾难？出什么事了吗，Molly？

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty7
: Nope! Just trying to take advantage of my high persuasion to fend off the Magistrate of Mammaries and earn some extra gacha money while I’m at it!
lines.zh: : 没有！我只是想用我超高的说服检定来挡开“胸部裁判官”，顺便再赚点抽卡的钱！

lines.en: : Besides, I have you two to help me if things get crazy again! And you are forced to do so as I determine the fates of your D&D characters!
lines.zh: : 再说了，要是再出乱子，我还有你们两个帮忙！而且你们非帮不可，因为你们 D&D 角色的命运由我决定！

lines.en: : It was only a matter of time until she started using this as leverage for blackmail.
lines.zh: : 她迟早会拿这个当勒索的筹码。

lines.en: : Silence, Urrheak!
lines.zh: : 住口，Urrheak！

lines.en: : Scraw.
: I don’t mind helping, but...if you let the Magistrate of Mammaries leave, she’ll take Sensei with her and that is bad.
lines.zh: : 帮忙我是没意见，不过……你要是放“胸部裁判官”走，她会把 Sensei 一起带走，那样可不好。

lines.en: : Can we...stop using that ridiculous nickname?
lines.zh: : 我们能不能……别再用那个蠢昵称了？

lines.en: : Silence, boob lady.
lines.zh: : 住口，大胸女士。

lines.en: : While it may be true that the two of them will spend more time together based on this decision, I have disabled rollback and am incapable of changing courses at this point in time!
lines.zh: : 虽然按这个决定，他们俩确实会多相处一段时间，但我已经关闭了回溯，此刻无法再改变航向！

lines.en: : Besides, side characters need love too!
lines.zh: : 再说了，配角也需要爱啊！

lines.en: : I’m a...side character?
lines.zh: : 我是……配角？

lines.en: : You’re all main characters to me, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 对我来说你们都是主角，Haruka。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty8
: But I’m the {i}main{/i} main character. Right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 可我才是{i}主{/i}主角。对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : I’m afraid that position belongs to me, Strawberry Songstress. Molly MacCormack is the ultimate heroine, after all.
lines.zh: : 恐怕那个位置属于我，草莓歌姬。Molly MacCormack 才是终极女主角，毕竟。

lines.en: : I’m actually going to give the main heroine spot to Maya for being so silent and disinterested in the position.
lines.zh: : 我倒想把女主角的位置给 Maya，因为她对这个位置足够沉默、足够不感兴趣。

lines.en: : Oh, good. Exactly what I wanted. Great.
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了。正是我想要的。太棒了。

lines.en: : So...uhh...I guess I have the night off now?
lines.zh: : 那么……呃……看来我今晚算是放假了？

lines.en: : I guess you do.
lines.zh: : 看来是。

lines.en: : Does this mean we’re going to actually do something for once?
lines.zh: : 这是不是意味着，我们终于要真的做点什么了？

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty9
: Do something? Us?
lines.zh: : 做点什么？我们俩？

lines.en: : But we never do anything. Not doing anything is kind of our thing.
lines.zh: : 可我们从来什么都没做过啊。“什么都不做”才像是我们的风格。

lines.en: : There’s always...the bar, I guess?
lines.zh: : 总还有……酒吧吧，我想？

lines.en: : I mean...I have a change of clothes in my office...
lines.zh: : 我是说……我办公室里还有套换洗衣服……

lines.en: : But Sara and I just got into an argument about which Avenger is the hottest and I’m currently mad at her.
lines.zh: : 不过我刚跟 Sara 吵了一架，争论哪个复仇者最火辣，我现在还在生她的气。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty10
: Ooooh, who was your choice?! Iron Man?! Thor?!
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，你选的是谁？！钢铁侠？！雷神？！

lines.en: : {i}Black Widow.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}黑寡妇。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Nice.{/i}
: I have no idea what’s going on, but I was thinking maybe some bar that isn’t owned by Sara.
lines.zh: : 我完全没听懂，不过我在想，能不能去一家不是 Sara 开的酒吧。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty11
: Are you sure? She could really use the business.
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？她现在真的很需要生意。

lines.en: : She’ll figure it out.
lines.zh: : 她会想办法的。

lines.en: : I say we take advantage of my newfound desire to do something and go to the urban district.
lines.zh: : 我建议趁着我这股难得的“想做点什么”的劲头，去市区逛逛。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty12
: All the way over there? Are you serious?
lines.zh: : 大老远跑那儿去？你认真的？

lines.en: : Good luck with your bonus CG, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 祝您解锁特典 CG 顺利，Sensei。

lines.en: : That makes it sound like a date! You never take me to the urban district! I wanna go!
lines.zh: : 这听着像约会！你从来不带我去市区！我也要去！

lines.en: : It’s not a date. Haruka and I are just friends.
lines.zh: : 不是约会。Haruka 和我只是朋友。

lines.en: : I suddenly feel like a college kid about to go bar hopping again.
lines.zh: : 我突然有种回到大学时代、准备去串酒吧的感觉。

lines.en: : Just don’t get so drunk that I have to carry you home.
lines.zh: : 只是别醉到得让我背你回家。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty13
: Challenge accepted! I’ll go get dressed right now.
lines.zh: : 挑战接受！我现在就去换衣服。

lines.en: scene black
Haruka thanks Molly one more time before heading to her office to change out of her work clothes.
lines.zh: Haruka 又谢了 Molly 一次，然后去办公室换下工作服。

lines.en: She comes back a few minutes later and the two of us say goodbye to the rest of the girls, who have already started debating some geeky stuff I couldn’t be bothered to listen to.
lines.zh: 几分钟后她回来了，我们俩跟剩下那几个女孩道别——她们已经吵起某种我懒得听的宅话题了。

lines.en: It’s clear that at least Ami is uncomfortable with the idea of me going out with Haruka, but Ami is uncomfortable with pretty much everything I do, so that’s to be expected.
lines.zh: 看得出来，至少 Ami 对我跟 Haruka 出去这件事不太舒服，不过 Ami 对我做的几乎所有事都觉得不舒服，所以也在意料之中。

lines.en: Either way, Haruka and I wind up boarding a bus to the urban district and, in less than fifteen minutes, we’re wandering the streets...
lines.zh: 不管怎样，Haruka 和我最后还是上了去市区的公交车，不到十五分钟，我们就在街上闲逛了……

lines.en: scene nightsky
We wind up stopping at whichever bars we can find inside of the concrete jungle as the night ticks on and on.
lines.zh: 夜色一点点推移，我们最后就在这座水泥丛林里，随便撞见哪家酒吧就进哪家。

lines.en: I don’t know if it’s just all of the walking that’s keeping her sober-ish, but Haruka doesn’t seem fazed at all even after the fourth bar.
lines.zh: 我不知道是不是光靠走路就让她一直保持着半醉状态，但即使喝到第四家，Haruka 看起来也完全没上头。

lines.en: In fact, about two or three hours of drinking go by before I start to see any signs of inebriation in her at all. And even {i}I’m{/i} feeling a little buzzed at this point.
lines.zh: 事实上，足足喝了两三个小时，我才开始在她身上看到一点醉意。而这时候连{i}我自己{/i}都有点上头了。

lines.en: None of it feels out of the ordinary, though.
lines.zh: 不过这一切都没什么不寻常的。

lines.en: In fact, if you get rid of all the conversation, it hardly even seems like I’m out with {i}anyone{/i} right now.
lines.zh: 说实话，要是把所有对话去掉，我几乎都感觉不到自己现在是跟{i}人{/i}一起出来的。

lines.en: I don’t have to watch what I say (Which I never do anyway, to be completely fair) and I don’t have to mind what I do.
lines.zh: 我不用小心翼翼地斟酌措辞（平心而论，我本来也从来不），也不用留意自己的一举一动。

lines.en: We’re just two human beings spending more money than we probably should, and more time in new places than we typically would.
lines.zh: 我们只是两个人，花着本不该花的钱，在新地方待得比平时更久一些。

lines.en: It’s...a strangely good night.
lines.zh: 这是……一个出奇美好的夜晚。

lines.en: One that I doubt I’d ever be able to recreate with someone like Sara or Maki.
lines.zh: 我怀疑换成 Sara 或 Maki 那样的人，我永远也复制不出这样的夜晚。

lines.en: Maybe I...actually like doing things every once in a while?
lines.zh: 也许我……其实偶尔做点什么，也挺好的？

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty14
: Ah! Is that snow? Do you see snow, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 啊！那是雪吗？Sensei，你看见雪了吗？

lines.en: : Quick, look up. Before it melts.
lines.zh: : 快，抬头看。趁它还没化。

lines.en: : It’s just frozen rain. It’ll be gone before the weather even has a chance to get hotter.
lines.zh: : 那只是冻雨。等天气有机会转暖之前，它早就没了。

lines.en: : Oh, shut up. Don’t be such a buzzkill now that all of the bars are closing. Get excited about something for once.
lines.zh: : 哦闭嘴。酒吧都要打烊了，别这么扫兴。你就不能为点什么激动一回吗。

lines.en: : I’m not going to get excited about the water cycle, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 我可不会对水循环激动，Haruka。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty15
: Fine then. You pick.
lines.zh: : 那好吧。你来选。

lines.en: : What do you want to talk about?
lines.zh: : 你想聊什么？

lines.en: : Girls? Boys? Us?
lines.zh: : 女孩？男孩？我们？

lines.en: : Us?
lines.zh: : 我们？

lines.en: : Yeah, us.
lines.zh: : 对，我们。

lines.en: : I can’t be the only one thinking about how much fun tonight’s been, right?
lines.zh: : 总不会只有我一个人觉得今晚特别开心吧？

lines.en: : Like, I’m all for wrapping myself up in[teen]drama, but spending time away from it for a change and just...not focusing on anything with you has been pretty awesome.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我挺喜欢把自己埋进[teen]的狗血剧情里，不过偶尔抽身出来，跟你一起……什么都不想，感觉棒极了。

lines.en: : Even with Sara and stuff, it’s hard to really feel like...I don’t know, detached?
lines.zh: : 就算是跟 Sara 她们在一起，也很难真的感觉到……怎么说呢，抽离？

lines.en: : Detached from what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 从什么里面抽离？

lines.en: : Everything, dude.
lines.zh: : 从一切，老兄。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty16
: Like, it feels like...the rest of the world’s been deleted and that the urban district is all that’s left.
lines.zh: : 感觉就像是……这世界剩下的部分全被删掉了，只剩下这片市区。

lines.en: : And that we no longer have anything to actually worry about, so we’re just being ourselves and...enjoying it in the simplest way possible before everything comes back tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 我们再也没有什么真正需要担心的东西，于是就这么做回自己，在明天一切卷土重来之前，用最简单的方式……享受着。

lines.en: : Well, I’m glad you managed to have a good time.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我很高兴你玩得开心。

lines.en: : I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t having fun as well.
lines.zh: : 我如果说自己也没玩得开心，那就是在撒谎了。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty17
: Exactly! You’re the first guy since my husband that I’ve been able to feel like this with.
lines.zh: : 就是嘛！你是我丈夫之后，第一个能让我有这种感觉的男人。

lines.en: : Which isn’t me hitting on you, by the way. That’s not what I’m getting at here.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，这不是我在撩你。我想说的不是这个。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty18
: I’m just glad that we did this tonight.
lines.zh: : 我只是很高兴我们今晚做了这些。

lines.en: : Like, if you never called, I’d probably still be cleaning the cafe right about now.
lines.zh: : 要是你没打电话来，我这会儿大概还在打扫咖啡馆呢。

lines.en: : It’s been several hours and I highly doubt the girls are still there.
lines.zh: : 都过去好几个小时了，我很怀疑那几个女孩还在那儿。

lines.en: : Okay, whatever. I still want to thank you for saving me at least an hour of cleaning.
lines.zh: : 行吧，随便啦。我还是得谢谢你，替我省了至少一个小时的打扫。

lines.en: : You’re thankful too, right? For having me, I mean.
lines.zh: : 你也很庆幸吧？我是说，庆幸有我在。

lines.en: : Are you fishing for compliments now?
lines.zh: : 你这是在讨夸奖吗？

lines.en: : I’m not...{i}not{/i} fishing for compliments?
lines.zh: : 我不是……{i}不是{/i}在讨夸奖？

lines.en: : I don’t know. I’m a little drunk, but I’m basically just trying to say that it’s nice having somebody who feels like a real friend rather than just someone I’ve known for a bunch of years.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。我有点醉了，但我想说的其实就是——有个感觉像真正朋友的人在身边，而不是单纯认识了很多年的人，这感觉很好。

lines.en: : Sara and Maki are great, but...there’s never anything new with them.
lines.zh: : Sara 和 Maki 都很好，可是……跟她们在一起永远没有新鲜事。

lines.en: : And whether they want to believe it or not, they both kinda settled down and had kids and...
lines.zh: : 而且不管她们愿不愿意承认，她们两个都算是安定下来、生了孩子，然后……

lines.en: : And you never stopped being young.
lines.zh: : 而你从来没停止年轻过。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty19
: I...don’t know if I’d go that far.
lines.zh: : 我……不知道能不能说到这个程度。

lines.en: : I feel like, on at least some level, no one ever stops being young.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，至少在某种程度上，没有人会真正停止年轻。

lines.en: : It’s why even tiny things like going to bars or talking about the cute girls who served us at those bars can make us feel younger, even if it’s for just a little while.
lines.zh: : 所以即使是去酒吧、聊聊酒吧里招待我们的可爱女孩这种小事，也能让我们觉得自己年轻了些，哪怕只是短暂的一会儿。

lines.en: : And I’m sure Sara and Maki feel plenty young, too.
lines.zh: : 而且我相信 Sara 和 Maki 也觉得自己挺年轻的。

lines.en: : Sara...probably {i}too{/i} [young]at times. But her circumstances are a lot less normal than Maki’s, as weird as that is.
lines.zh: : Sara……有时候大概 [young] {i}过头{/i}了。不过她的处境比 Maki 要不正常得多——虽然这么说也有点怪。

lines.en: : If anything, it’s probably more like Sara has yet to grow up.
lines.zh: : 要说的话，更像是 Sara 还没长大。

lines.en: : People like you and me on the other hand...who are in that weird position of being old but not {i}that{/i} old...and having just started our careers and whatnot-
lines.zh: : 而像你我这样的人……处在一个很奇怪的位置上——说老不{i}老{/i}，事业又才刚起步什么的——

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty20
: It’s...cool.
lines.zh: : 这……挺好的。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I’m probably just happy that there’s someone I can relate to who doesn’t also want to paint my nails.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。大概我只是很高兴，能有个说得来的人，而且对方还不会想着给我涂指甲油。

lines.en: : Is this getting weird? I feel like I’m doing all of the talking and that I might be making a big deal out of something that’s just like, totally normal for you.
lines.zh: : 这会不会有点怪？感觉一直是我在说，而且我好像把一件对你来说完全稀松平常的事，搞得特别隆重。

lines.en: : No, I think you more or less explained how I’m feeling.
lines.zh: : 不，我觉得你差不多把我的感受也说出来了。

lines.en: : You just did it a lot more...positively, which I guess I’m thankful for.
lines.zh: : 只是你说得要……积极得多，这一点我想我是感激的。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty21
: Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : Positivity is something I definitely struggle with sometimes, but when I’m not too busy beating myself up over things that aren’t in my control or-
lines.zh: : 积极这东西，我有时候确实很难做到，不过只要我没忙着为那些我控制不了的事自责，或者——

lines.en: : Or fantasizing about your employees.
lines.zh: : 或者幻想你的员工。

lines.en: : Or fantasizing about my employees, thank you for that-
lines.zh: : 或者幻想我的员工，多谢提醒——

lines.en: : When I’m not too busy doing either of those things, I really try. You know?
lines.zh: : 只要我没忙着干这两件事，我是真的很努力的。你知道吧？

lines.en: if harukasex == True:
scene harukadatetwenty22
: And...
lines.zh: : 还有……

lines.en: : Well, it goes without saying but...
lines.zh: : 嗯，这不用说也知道，不过……

lines.en: : Sometimes I fail...
lines.zh: : 有时候我还是会失败……

lines.en: : And I do things that no one should ever do just because I’m impulsive or-
lines.zh: : 就因为一时冲动，或者别的什么，我会做出一些谁都不该做的事——

lines.en: : Haruka, you really don’t have to-
lines.zh: : Haruka，你真的不用——

lines.en: : No, hold on.
lines.zh: : 不，你听我说完。

lines.en: : Sometimes I do things like that because...because I’m only human.
lines.zh: : 有时候我会做那种事，是因为……因为我只是个普通人。

lines.en: : And...and all humans can be forgiven if they’re regretful enough.
lines.zh: : 而且……而且只要足够悔恨，所有人都能被原谅。

lines.en: : Are you regretful?
lines.zh: : 你后悔吗？

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty23
: I want to be.
lines.zh: : 我想后悔。

lines.en: : It’s just...a lot harder when there are nights like this, where the takeaway is that...maybe I was never ready to settle down at all?
lines.zh: : 只是……有像今晚这样的夜晚会难得多，因为最后得出的结论是……也许我从来就没有准备好安定下来？

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : Just...thanks, I guess.
lines.zh: : 总之……谢谢你吧。

lines.en: : For what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 具体谢我什么？

lines.en: : For kind of...brute forcing me into realizing that I don’t understand why I do certain things or...or feel certain things.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你……硬生生地让我意识到，我不明白自己为什么会做某些事，或者……会有某些感觉。

lines.en: : And for giving me moments where I don’t have to deal with any of that and can just...have fun instead.
lines.zh: : 也谢谢你给了我一些时刻，让我不用去面对那些，只需要……好好玩就行。

lines.en: else:
scene harukadatetwenty18
: Actually, you don’t even have to answer that.
lines.zh: : 其实你连回答都不用。

lines.en: : I know you know.
lines.zh: : 我知道你心里清楚。

lines.en: : You’ve had...several opportunities to push me into things that would be bad for our relationship, and you haven’t taken any of them.
lines.zh: : 你有过……好几次机会，可以把我推进那些会伤害我们关系的事里，可你一次都没那么做。

lines.en: : In fact, you’ve even gone out of your way on nights like tonight to remind me that it’s okay to just...let myself go in ways that aren’t totally self-destructive.
lines.zh: : 事实上，在像今晚这样的夜晚，你还特意让我知道——用不那么自毁的方式放纵一下，也没关系。

lines.en: : And, weirdly enough, I feel less alone tonight than I have in a long time.
lines.zh: : 而且说来也怪，今晚我感到的孤独，比这很长一段时间以来都要少。

lines.en: : So, thank you...really.
lines.zh: : 所以，谢谢你……真的。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty24
: There’s no point in thanking me.
lines.zh: : 谢我也没什么意义。

lines.en: : Just live however you want and let whatever is going to happen just...happen.
lines.zh: : 你想怎么活就怎么活，该发生的就让它……发生吧。

lines.en: : Sure, there might not be a point in it...but I’m still going to thank you anyway.
lines.zh: : 是啊，也许没什么意义……可我还是想谢谢你。

lines.en: : Even if none of that had ever happened and this was the first time we’d hung out, I’d still thank you.
lines.zh: : 就算那些事从未发生过，就算这是我们第一次一起出去玩，我一样会谢你。

lines.en: : Why, though? I haven't even done anything.
lines.zh: : 可为什么呢？我明明什么都没做。

lines.en: : That's not true.
lines.zh: : 才不是。

lines.en: : For example...Tonight, you helped me remember that being [young]isn’t everything by choosing to go out with me instead of spending your time with three hormonal [teenager]s.
lines.zh: : 比如说……今晚你选择跟我出来，而不是把时间花在三个荷尔蒙过剩的 [teenager] 身上，这让我想起来，[young] 并不是一切。

lines.en: : Two hormonal [teenager]s and one weird shrine maiden.
lines.zh: : 是两个荷尔蒙过剩的 [teenager]，外加一个奇怪的巫女。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty25
: If you think for a second that third girl doesn’t get under the covers and finger herself at least once a week, boy do I have news for you.
lines.zh: : 你要是觉得那第三个女孩每周至少不会躲进被窝里自己来一次，那我可真有消息要告诉你了。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : Nothing. I like that image.
lines.zh: : 没什么。我喜欢那个画面。

lines.en: : I just can’t help but feel like she’s listening in and judging me at every moment, so I’m being careful to not inadvertently upset her.
lines.zh: : 我只是总觉得她随时都在偷听、在评判我，所以我得小心点，别一不留神惹她不高兴。

lines.en: : Well...whatever. You get what I'm saying.
lines.zh: : 嗯……算了。你懂我意思就行。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwenty24
: We...should probably start heading back now, though.
lines.zh: : 不过……我们大概该往回走了。

lines.en: : We’re already heading to the bus stop. Where did you think we’ve been walking this whole time?
lines.zh: : 我们已经在往公交站走了。你以为这一路我们是在往哪儿走？

lines.en: : I don’t know. I haven’t really been paying attention.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我一直没怎么注意。

lines.en: : That or you’re actually just a lot more drunk than you're letting on.
lines.zh: : 要么就是你其实比表现出来的醉得多。

lines.en: : You’ve seen me drunk. This isn’t drunk Haruka.
lines.zh: : 你见过我喝醉的样子。现在这样可不是醉了的 Haruka。

lines.en: : Drunk Haruka would have taken that thing about the third girl a lot further and then gotten way too excited.
lines.zh: : 醉了的 Haruka 会把刚才那个第三个女孩的话题发挥得更远，然后兴奋得不得了。

lines.en: : I kind of wish you {i}were{/i} drunk now.
lines.zh: : 我倒是有点希望你这会儿{i}是{/i}醉的。

lines.en: : Heheh...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……

lines.en: : If only there were still some bars open...
lines.zh: : 要是还有酒吧开着就好了……

lines.en: scene black
Haruka and I make it to the bus stop a few minutes later and get on board.
lines.zh: 几分钟后，Haruka 和我到了公交站，上了车。

lines.en: I get off at her stop despite it being miles away from my home.
lines.zh: 我在她那一站下了车，尽管那里离我家有好几英里。

lines.en: I’m not sure why.
lines.zh: 我不确定为什么。

lines.en: But I say goodbye to her without so much as a parting hug and begin my journey back to the house.
lines.zh: 但我连一个告别拥抱都没有，就这么跟她道了别，踏上了回家的路。

lines.en: The alcohol wears off somewhere around the halfway point and I become uncomfortably cold.
lines.zh: 走到一半左右，酒劲散了，我开始冷得难受。

lines.en: That discomfort feels a lot less serious, however, when I realize it’s nothing compared to what Haruka must feel every time she sees me.
lines.zh: 不过等我意识到，这点难受跟 Haruka 每次见到我时必然的感受比起来根本算不了什么，它也就没那么严重了。

lines.en: What an interesting dynamic the two of us have.
lines.zh: 我们俩之间的关系，还真是耐人寻味。
